title: AI Outfit Generator
summary: Free AI outfit generator: design outfits and try looks on your own character, from streetwear to film costumes, a flat lay or a costume plot. Free to try.
body_markdown:
### Is there a free AI outfit generator?


Yes. Flick is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6, which made every outfit on this page, costs 5 credits an image.


### How do I generate outfits for my own character?


Make or upload a full body picture of the character on a plain background, add it as a reference image, then describe the new outfit piece by piece and ask the model to keep the same face, hair and build.


### Can AI design costumes for a film?


Yes. Describe the film's period or world, the character's role and what each piece is made of, and ask for wear such as frayed seams or oil marks; a costume plot with the character in each costume in story order helps plan the whole wardrobe.


### Can I try an outfit from a photo of the clothes?


Yes. Add the photo of the clothes as a second reference image and say that the face comes from the character and the outfit from the clothes; GPT Image 2.6 takes up to 10 reference images.


### Will the AI keep my character's face the same?


Mostly. An image model redraws the whole picture, so small details can drift; a clear reference, a line asking for the same face and hair, and editing the original reference each time keep the closest likeness.


### Can I make outfit ideas for a real event?


Yes. Describe the event, the weather and the dress code, such as an autumn wedding or a summer festival, and ask for two or three different outfits for the same person to compare them side by side.


### Can I turn an outfit into a video?


Yes. Use the finished outfit image as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe one movement, such as a slow turn that swings a coat, and ask it to keep the outfit exactly as it is.
